items.q: What does Peter McKinnon say to buy on day one?
items.a: **One notebook and any pen.** Friends texted **$800 Amazon carts** after his last video. Leather covers, typewriters, stamps, and pen-ranking wait until you have **finished two books**.

items.q: Pocket or A5 if you have never journaled?
items.a: **Pocket**, especially with an **ADHD** brain. One A5 page is **two to three** pocket pages; a large book took him **~3 months** then **~2 months off**. Small books finish sooner and seasonal **Field Notes** covers make the next one fun. A5 wins only on **hand comfort**.

items.q: What did his first notebooks contain?
items.a: **Messy lists** from **December 2022**: Polar Pro, Epidemic, Instagram posts, and a whole day that was just **'having a real hard time getting anything done today.'** Then shot lists so the book stays in the pocket. **No aesthetic tax.**

items.q: What three prompts does he give for a blank first page?
items.a: **Greatest thing this week so far.** How you feel about the **incoming season**. **Three questions** you still have about analog journaling. If nothing comes, **skip the day** without making it a thing. Kid drawings count.

items.q: Why keep a shot list in a notebook instead of the phone?
items.a: The phone opens **Instagram, tracking numbers, and 17 texts** and buzzes for **30 minutes**. The notebook **locks you in the moment**. Putting it on paper is also how the process **gets into your head**.

items.q: When are two notebooks, typewriters, and archive splits allowed?
items.a: After **two finished books**. A friend later **recycles the errand book** and keeps the memory book. McKinnon numbers spines because Field Notes dates were not enough. **The only layout on day one is that a pocket notebook will be started.**

items.q: What is 'ephemera hunting,' and is it for beginners?
items.a: Later: request **paper boarding passes**, glue tickets, F1 cards, photo-booth strips. A desk drawer of unused scraps. **Not day one.** A copied **15-minute day tracker** taught him nothing — start anyway so trial and error can happen.
